reasoning:

Canvas: 400x300.

Bicycle: two wheels at y=220, radius 45, positioned at x=100 and x=300. Frame connecting them, seatpost, saddle, handlebars, crank/pedals.

Pelican: body above saddle, long neck, head, large beak with pouch, wing, legs on pedals.

Let me lay it out:

- Rear wheel center (110, 230), front wheel center (310, 230), radius 42.
- Crank center around (200, 230), chainring radius 16.
- Frame: seat tube from crank (200,230) to saddle (175, 150); top tube from (175,155) to head tube top (280, 145); down tube from crank to head tube bottom (285, 160); chainstay from crank to rear hub (110,230); seatstay from saddle area to rear hub; fork from head tube to front hub (310,230).
- Handlebars at (280,140) extending up/right.
- Saddle at (172, 148).

Pelican: body is an ellipse centered at (185, 115), rotated slightly; neck curves upward from front of body to head at (250, 70); beak points right, long with pouch; small circle eye; wing as ellipse atop body; legs from bottom of body to pedal: pedal positions are crank center ± radius 16: pedal at (212, 242) and (188, 218). Legs are lines with feet.

Wheels: circle with spokes (lines).

Colors: pelican body white/light gray, beak orange/yellow, pouch orange, dark accents.

Let me write out the SVG.

Spokes: lines from hub through the center at various angles. Draw lines at 0°, 45°, 90°, 135° as chords passing through center (4 lines per wheel), plus small hub circle.

Pelican details:
- Body: ellipse cx=185 cy=112 rx=48 ry=32, fill white, stroke #555.
- Tail: small triangle at back left pointing left: (140,100) to (118,92), (138,118).
- Neck: path from (215,95) curving up to (248,62). Thick stroke, white with dark stroke? Better to use a filled path. Neck: path M210,90 C215,60 230,50 250,55 L252,72 C238,70 228,80 226,100 Z, fill white stroke.
- Head: circle at (252,62) r=13, fill white stroke.
- Beak: upper mandible from (262,55) to tip (330,62), long triangle-ish, orange. Pouch: curve bulging down from (262,70) to (325,70): path M262,62 Q290,95 325,66 Q295,75 262,72 Z fill orange-ish.

Simplified: upper beak: polygon (258,54) (330,60) (258,68). Pouch: path M258,66 Q292,92 328,62 L328,60... fill darker orange.

Eye: circle (254,58) r=2.5 dark.

Wing: rotated ellipse atop body: path M160,105 Q185,85 215,110 Q190,125 160,105 Z fill light gray #ddd stroke.

Legs: stroke lines from (195,140) to pedal. Legs pinkish/dark gray. Leg 1: (200,138) to (212,242)? Too long; knees optional. Simply: line from lower body (200,140) to knee (215,185), then foot (212,240). Pedal: small rect at (212,242). Other leg partly hidden behind frame: (190,138) to (185,200), foot (188,216).

Crank arms: lines from (200,230) to (212,244) and to (188,216).

Handlebars: from head tube top (280,142) curve up: path M280,146 Q282,125 300,122 stroke dark; grip. Wing/tip near handlebar: maybe add small wing holding handlebar — skip, keep simple.

Also add ground line at y=274.

Chain: line from chainring to rear hub, maybe skip or keep simple.

Frame stroke color red, width 5.

Text unnecessary. Let me compose.

Check front wheel hub: (310,230), r=42, spokes. Front fork: (285,158) to (310,230). Head tube: (280,142) to (286,162). Down tube: crank (200,230) to (284,160). Top tube: (176,152) to (281,146). Seat tube: (200,230) to (174,150) — seatpost extends from top of seat tube to saddle at (170,145). Seatstay: (178,152) to (110,230). Chainstay: (200,230) to (110,230).

Saddle: path or small ellipse at (172,143).

Pelican feet on pedals — pedals at (214,246) and (186,214).

OK, let me write the SVG with comments.
